answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 48504 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: missing fajr prayer Question: We r 3 students living in India for studies, alhamdulilah we belong 2 Islamic background. Sometimes we miss our Fajr prayer unintentionally in spite of keeping an alarm. We are scared as there is a hadith saying that a person has to get burnt for 2,88,00,000 years for missing any prayer. Is there any kafarah for this? Answer ID: 48504 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1729/1316/H=12/1434) Fear of Allah is good thing. One who fears Allah he may be safe from many evils and sins, in-shaAllah. He will tend to virtuous deeds and thus the stages of grave and resurrection will - in-shaAllah - easily be covered. You should make qadha of the missed salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
